verdict.rationale: Runpod can be driven entirely without the console. It ships an open-source CLI (runpodctl) with scriptable commands such as `pod create`. A REST API v1 is described as being for "automation systems", alongside a GraphQL API, Serverless SDKs for Python/JS/Go, and API-key authentication for the Flash CLI, which together suit headless and CI automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions, non-interactive auth guidance), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
